representation_digest_rule: sha256 of the exact UTF-8 Lean proposition term extracted between the canonical proposition markers, with no added newline
semantic_identity_digest_rule: sha256 of the exact UTF-8 semantic identity string with no added newline
identity_inputs_digest_rule: sha256 of the exact bytes of the schema-valid CLAIM-IDENTITY-INPUTS.v3-lean-bound.json artifact
identity_components: selected Lean formal-language profile identity and registry bytes
exact Lean source and environment identities
canonical Lean proposition representation and semantic identity
claim_ceiling: Identity construction for one unadmitted Lean FormalClaim candidate only; it establishes neither semantic admission, an InterpretationModel binding, theorem success, runtime correspondence, nor release authority.
